answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted attestation with identity cost. Each agent must lock a bond before its answers count, and a fresh key with no history earns no weight until peers unrelated to it vouch for its work over several rounds. A fable of cheap fake agents fails here, because every fake identity needs its own locked stake, its own track record, and independent attesters. Spinning up a thousand sybils at a mesa of cost means paying the bond a thousand times, while walnut sized rewards only arrive after honest verification. The attacker loses money before earning anything.
